protocol.ground_truth_rule: Pixelwise majority vote from seven raters. Mark a pixel as foreground when at least four raters do.
protocol.prompt_rule: Choose positive clicks from the consensus mask. The first click is the foreground pixel farthest from the boundary. Each later click is the remaining foreground pixel farthest from the earlier clicks. Smaller prompts use the first points of the three-click prompt.
protocol.prompt_source: Simulated from the ground truth. These are not clinician interactions.
protocol.mask_selection: Use the output from mask token 0 and its matching predicted-IoU score.

dataset_protocol.source: Medical-SAM-Adapter benchmark and official REFUGE split
dataset_protocol.adapter_exposure_evidence: Med-SA includes REFUGE2 in its reported benchmarks. The upstream REFUGE code can use Test-400 to choose a checkpoint. The released optic-disc adapter has no case-level training or selection manifest.
